description: Marginal effects under resample (U69 #639): manual replicate loops in base R, each replicate refitting lm / glm on its rows and recomputing the effect (ame, mem or the 0/1 contrast) itself. Jackknife: SE = sqrt((g-1)/g sum (e_k - ebar)^2), p the Wald z of the full-data effect. Bootstrap: SE = sd over the recorded index sets (samples, 0-based), p the percentile p floored at 1/B. Interval: full-data effect -/+ qnorm(0.975) SE. Rows are [x1, x2, y, g, f].
